itemUsage.en: An ordinary citizen of Kjerag, with a renewed Rhodes Island contract, joins the battlefield once more.
itemUsage.zh: 一个普通的谢拉格公民，已与罗德岛续约，重新介入战场。

itemDesc.en: An uncrowned king, warlord, dictator... there are many names people call him, but you recognize who he is, do you not?
itemDesc.zh: 无冕之王、军阀、独裁者……对他的称呼有很多。但你认得出他是谁，不是吗？

description.en: Immediately gains <@ba.vup>{cost}</> DP. The Operator nearest to 'Eye of the Blizzard' in the Deployment Waiting Zone has <@ba.vup>-{svash2_s_1[deck].cost}</> DP Cost (Prioritizes <@ba.vup>Guard/Caster/Sniper</> Operator on the right), and gains a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{svash2_s_1[deck].shield:0%}</> of SilverAsh the Reignfrost's Max HP upon deployment
description.zh: 立刻获得<@ba.vup>{cost}</>点部署费用。待部署区中距离“风雪之眼”最近的1名干员费用<@ba.vup>-{svash2_s_1[deck].cost}</>（优先选择右侧<@ba.vup>近卫/术师/狙击</>干员），且部署后获得相当于凛御银灰最大生命值<@ba.vup>{svash2_s_1[deck].shield:0%}</>的<$ba.barrier>屏障</>

description.en:
Deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to 6 enemies in front, inflicts <$ba.cold>Cold</> on them and removes their <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> for <@ba.vup>{cold}</> seconds; the Operator nearest to 'Eye of the Blizzard' has <@ba.vup>-{cost}</> DP Cost (Prioritizes <@ba.vup>Guard/Caster/Sniper</> Operator on the right); All Operators to the left of 'Eye of the Blizzard' cast this skill <@ba.vup>with their own ATK</> once when deployed (stacks 2 times) 
<@ba.rem>Can store 2 charges</>
description.zh: 对前方6名敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害，使其<@ba.vup>{cold}</>秒内<$ba.cold>寒冷</>且<$ba.invisible>隐匿</>失效；待部署区中距离“风雪之眼”最近的1名干员费用<@ba.vup>-{cost}</>（优先选择右侧<@ba.vup>近卫/术师/狙击</>干员）；使“风雪之眼”左侧所有干员部署时以<@ba.vup>自身攻击力</>施放一次本技能的范围效果（最多叠加2次）\n<@ba.rem>可充能2次</>

description.en:
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, removes enemies' <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{bird_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage and inflict <@ba.vup>{damage_scale_display:0%}</> <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> to targets in a straight line; immediately gains <@ba.vup>{svash2_s_3[start_cost].cost}</> DP, then gradually gains <@ba.vup>24</> DP

description.en:
"Rhine Lab's profit model is truly astonishing."
At a top-floor restaurant in Trimounts, Enciodes SilverAsh spoke with sincere tone to Justin Fitzroy and Yara Booke Wilson.
Now that the Kjerag Rhine Park was finally operating smoothly, they were no strangers to one another. Justin smiled: "Do enlighten me."
"I am not saying you have done poorly, Fitzroy. Without you, Rhine Lab would have long since gone bankrupt and been liquidated. Rather, Rhine Lab's personnel are frighteningly competent. The Commercial Division secures adequate political, military, and corporate orders; the Director matches them with each division's projects; every division delivers results each cycle; and the Commercial Division packages those results to fulfill the orders' demands. Rhine Lab has grown to this day while shedding efficiency at every turn, and I can only say that every single one of Rhine Lab's ten department directors is a prodigy."
"Yet Fitzroy, do you think—if I may be so polite—that this is healthy?"
Yara replied gently: "Rhine Lab has its own genes. Some changes Rhine Lab simply cannot bear."
SilverAsh nodded: "Of course, you are the one who understands this best."
"But what if a company were born that did only one thing: the commercial development of Rhine Lab's technology, and such development never took precedence over scientific research? There would be no need to painstakingly hunt for orders and demands, and Rhine Lab's technological deliverables would no longer be restricted to specialized or military applications. Once the structure I speak of is in motion, Rhine Lab may have the opportunity to enter the mass consumer market. Fitzroy, you must understand what this means."
Justin raised his voice slightly: "You know, someone has tried to do this."
"I believe so," SilverAsh said. "And he failed, did he not? Let me guess, the reason for his failure was lack of money."
"He certainly needed seed capital. And if I may say so, Rhine Lab's past and present sources of capital... leave much to be desired."
Justin made a regretful expression. Yara knew he had relaxed; just as before, these two found it easy to converse.
SilverAsh turned to Yara instead, saying: "Moreover, neither of you wishes for that kind of money to enter Rhine Lab."
"Yet now I can offer an option: no money will enter Rhine Lab, but rather Rhine Lab's capital will enter that hypothetical company."
A smile appeared once more on Justin's face, with a keen interest: "Not only Rhine Lab's capital will be in there, but what will our 'partner' gain in return?"
Rhine Lab's technology pool—Justin silently muttered the answer to himself.
Yet the man's reply was not this. Yara's eyes were concealed behind her sunglasses, yet SilverAsh still met her gaze precisely.
His pace of speech slowed slightly: "I do not know whether the two of you have considered similar questions, but this is a question I cannot help but ponder—Where is Kjerag's frontier?"
"In only one direction, Kjerag and Terra share the same frontier."
"And in this single direction, Kjerag is the nation in all of Terra closest to this frontier."
Yara removed her sunglasses, realizing that these very words were the reason for her presence today. She had been invited to inspect his sincerity. SilverAsh nodded to her respectfully.
"I have always felt the name 'barrier' to be misleading. If we grow accustomed to calling something a 'barrier,' we invariably forfeit some room for beneficial imagination concerning ourselves. Yet the starting point of it all was Kristen Wright of Rhine Lab showing me this matter. I believe I ought to thank Rhine Lab, and aside from annoying empty fame and clamorous trouble, you too ought to receive a true reward."
"'The wild ravings of a merchant who holds science in contempt!'" Justin said. "You know, that is usually what I hear from my colleagues."
"Yet you are not, and both you and your colleagues know it."
SilverAsh slid a pristine white card toward the two of them, upon which bore a single name.
"Merely a temporary business card. In Trimounts, there is as yet no other information to write upon it. I hope before long I may print a new box, and I eagerly await the advice the two of you give me today." The man named Enciodes SilverAsh smiled at them once more; he appeared quite sincere.
description.zh:
“莱茵生命的收益模式真是令人惊讶。”
特里蒙某间顶层餐厅，恩希欧迪斯·希瓦艾什对小贾斯汀·菲茨罗伊和雅拉·布克·威尔森说，语气诚挚。
在谢拉格莱茵园区终于平稳运作的现在，他们并不陌生，小贾斯汀微笑：“愿闻其详。”
“我不是在说菲茨罗伊你做得不好，若没有你，莱茵早已破产被清算。不如说莱茵的成员优秀得可怕，商务科能拉到足量的政军企订单，总辖能将它们和各科室课题相匹配，各科室在每轮周期中都做出了成果，商务科又将成果包装成订单所需求的交付——莱茵能以这种层层损失效率的方式壮大至今，我只能说莱茵十科主任每一名都是奇才。”
“但菲茨罗伊，你觉得——我说得礼貌一点——这健康吗？”
雅拉温和地回答：“莱茵有它的基因，有些改变是莱茵不能承受的。”
希瓦艾什点点头：“当然，您是最了解这一点的人。”
“但如果，诞生了这样一个公司：它只做一件事，莱茵技术的商业化开发，且这种开发永不超越于科研目的之先。不需要苦寻订单和需求，莱茵的技术落地产物也不再局限于专用或军用型，在我所说的结构运转起来后，莱茵将可能有机会进入大众消费市场。菲茨罗伊，你一定明白这意味着什么。”
小贾斯汀稍微提高了声音：“你知道吗，有人尝试过做这件事。”
“我相信。”希瓦艾什说，“但他失败了，对吗？让我猜一猜，他失败的原因是没有钱。”
“他一定需要第一笔钱。而恕我直言，过去和现在的莱茵，能搞到钱的地方……都不怎么理想。”
小贾斯汀做出一个遗憾的表情。雅拉知道他已经放松下来了，就和此前一样，这两个人很容易聊得来。
希瓦艾什则转向了雅拉，说：“而且，你们也并不希望那样的钱进入莱茵。”
“但现在我可以提供一个选项：不会有钱进入莱茵，而是莱茵的钱会进入那个假设的公司之中。”
笑容又出现在小贾斯汀的脸上，他颇有兴致：“那里面不会只有莱茵的钱，可我们的‘伙伴’又能得到什么呢？”
莱茵生命的技术池，小贾斯汀在心中默念出答案。
可男人给出的回答并不是这个。雅拉的眼睛隐藏在墨镜后，希瓦艾什依旧准确地对上了她的视线。
他语速稍缓：“我不知道两位是否考虑过类似的问题，但这是个我不得不去想的问题——谢拉格的边疆在哪里？”
“只在一个方向上，谢拉格与泰拉共享同一个边疆。”
“且只在这一个方向上，谢拉格是全泰拉最接近这道边疆的国家。”
雅拉取下了墨镜，她意识到这些话就是她今天在场的原因。她被邀请来检视他的诚意。希瓦艾什尊重地向她点了点头。
“我一直觉得‘阻隔层’这个名字易于误导，如果我们习惯把一个东西叫做‘阻隔’，一定会损失一些于自身有益的设想空间。但一切的起点，是莱茵生命的克丽斯腾·莱特让我看到了这件事。我认为我应当感谢莱茵生命，而除了恼人的虚名和嘈杂的麻烦，你们也应当得到真正的回报。”
“‘视科学为无物的野心家商人的狂想！’”小贾斯汀说，“你知道吗，通常是我从我的同事们那里听到这句话。”
“但你不是，你和你的同事们都知道。”
希瓦艾什将一张洁白的卡片推向两人，那上面仅仅只有一个名字。
“只是临时制作的名片，在特里蒙，上面暂时还没有别的信息可写。希望不久之后我就能印一盒新的，我很期待两位今天给我的建议。”名为恩希欧迪斯·希瓦艾什的男人再度向他们微笑，他看上去相当真诚。
